sources.limitations: Nine rear/dorsal moth poses; six selected from wing-open hover through descent and progressively folded ground rest. Dorsal abdomen and upper wing surfaces remain visible; lying head shows a lateral eye. End body and wings lie flat, legs no longer support hover. Owner review for oblique heading readability at the small endpoint.

Nine rear/dorsal poses. Front-turn key 7 excluded. Quick clip selects a sharp folded-wing recoil and return; heavy sweeps four wings and bends thorax then recovers. Pale generated sweep wisps remain around some keys as localized motion paint, not labels. No claim that every requested pose or grid was followed; owner review for recoil versus ordinary wingbeat.

Four usable generated front-right keys: source 2 hovers front-on, 3 descends, 4 folds wings low, 5 rests thorax and folded wings against ground. First two rear-facing keys excluded. Honest four-key collapse, no duplicate keys added. Midnight-blue wings, silver veins and intact insect anatomy retained; subtle body altitude is owner-review.

Nine front moth poses. Short clip flares and counter-sweeps wings then returns to folded hover. Heavy clip turns thorax, folds wings unevenly and catches balance before recovering. Four-wing silhouette, silver veins and midnight pigment retained; eyes are brighter violet than original and route to owner for identity review. No ground poses used in hits.
